newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta exchange suspends trading in Bayu.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta exchange suspends trading in Bayu.

text.p: The Jakarta Stock Exchange suspended trading in travel and tourism firm PT Bayu Buana shortly after the open on Tuesday, officials said.
"We have suspended trading in Bayu Buana starting from 9:30 a.m. (0230 GMT)," Nurmai, an official at the bourse's controlling department, told Reuters.
The bourse opened at that time, but some trades were concluded before the order went into effect, brokers said. Bayu was up 25 rupiah at 1,275 when it was frozen.
Nurmai said trading was suspended because the company has not responded to a letter from the bourse asking it to explain a sharp rise of about 25 percent on Monday.
"That is the standard procedure. We will not resume the trading until the issuer gives a response to our letter," he said.

On Monday, Bayu Buana closed 250 rupiah higher at 1,250 rupiah on active trading of about 4.8 million shares due to market talk that the firm was a target of a possible take-over by another company, brokers said.
Company officials were not available for comment.
